content.tex: You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this section.
This investigation looks at the minimum number of moves it takes to win the game of Nim. Nim is a game for two players using a pile of sticks.
In this game, you and your friend take turns to remove sticks from the pile. A player wins when they take the last stick.

parts.text: In each move, a player takes 1 or 2 sticks from the pile. There are 3 sticks in the pile. Your friend starts the game. Your friend takes 1 stick from the pile, leaving 2. You win by taking the remaining 2 sticks. The table shows these moves. move number of sticks taken number of sticks left in the pile result 3 1 friend takes 1 2 2 you take 2 0 you win There is another way for you to win the game when your friend starts. This time your friend takes 2 sticks from the pile. move number of sticks taken number of sticks left in the pile result 3 1 friend takes 2 1 2 you take 1 0 you win
